trial_court: Sessions Court No.1, Chittorgarh in Sessions Case No.34/2014

parties.respondent_defendant: The State of Rajasthan and Smt. Sumanlata Meena

facts_of_case: Complainant lodged a report against the petitioner and four others alleging that she was deserted by her husband and the accused seduced her with false assurances.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the prosecution to prove that the marriage was not dissolved.
legal_principles.held: Neither in the detailed complaint nor in the statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., did the complainant allege that her previous marriage with Bhanwar Singh Meena had ever been dissolved.

legal_principles.principle: A party cannot enter into a valid marriage with someone while still married to another person.
legal_principles.held: It is evident from these material pieces of evidence that the prosecutrix was married to one Shri Bhanwar Singh Meena when she established the illicit liaison with the accused.

outcome.final_order: Charges were framed against the appellant for the offences under Sections 493, 496, 420 and 376 IPC.

use_for_drafting: responding to charges in a criminal case
